name: pratham-transcription
description: Local Streamlit UI for streamed Google Drive video transcription

scripts.build: (.venv/bin/python scripts/validate_build.py || python3.12 scripts/validate_build.py || python3 scripts/validate_build.py) && cd pitch-studio/frontend && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build && cd ../.. && (cd pitch-studio && PYTHONPATH=. ../.venv/bin/python -m compileall -q backend || cd pitch-studio && PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m compileall -q backend)
